Optimiser les résultats quantitatifs et qualitatifs, en ligne avec les engagements et objectifs fixés par le groupe.
Gérer le personnel : management, formation, motivation, ainsi que l’élaboration des plannings et des congés.
Conseiller et vendre les produits, tout en garantissant un service client de qualité.
En tant que représentant des marques : gérer les relations externes locales, acquérir et fidéliser la clientèle.
Gérer et suivre le stock, participer aux inventaires.
Veiller au bon fonctionnement de la surface de vente : gestion des vitrines, ouverture/fermeture des caisses, et maintien de la propreté.
Profile
Vous disposez d'un CFC d’employé/e de commerce de détail ou tout autre formation jugée équivalente.
Une expérience dans le domaine de l’horlogerie est fortement souhaitée.
Vous disposez d’une expérience prouvée dans le management d’équipe et/ou dans la gestion commerciale d’une boutique.

Vous savez fédérer et motiver une équipe. Vous êtes également orienté résultats, afin d’atteindre vos objectifs avec efficacité.
Vous avez un esprit analytique, avec une approche structurée et une capacité à résoudre les problèmes.

Store Manager 100% – Shop-in-Shop Manor Lausanne
The company
Swatch Group is a world leader in the design, manufacture and sale of high-precision watches, jewellery, movements and watch components. The group is also a key player in the manufacture of innovative electronic systems, used in watchmaking and other industrial sectors.
Swatch Group Les Boutiques SA manages multi-brand distribution networks in Switzerland and has 7 Shop-in-Shops in Manor stores across the country.
• We offer brands such as Swatch, Tissot, Balmain, Mido, Rado, Hamilton and Certina. In order to complete our team, we are looking for an indeterminate one/one:
Job description
You will be responsible for the organisation and proper functioning of the shop, while respecting the company's internal policy. In addition to team management, you will be in charge of sales and ensure exemplary customer contact.
Tasks:
Be responsible for the turnover of the shop and the achievement of sales objectives.
Optimize quantitative and qualitative results, in line with the commitments and objectives set by the group.
Managing staff: management, training, motivation, as well as planning and leave.
Advise and sell products, while guaranteeing quality customer service.
As a brand representative: managing local external relations, acquiring and retaining customers.
Manage and track stock, participate in inventories.
Ensure the proper functioning of the sales area: window management, opening/closing of cases, and maintaining cleanliness.
Profile
You have an EFA or other training deemed equivalent.
An experience in the field of watchmaking is highly desired.
You have proven experience in team management and/or business management of a shop.
Professional requirements
You know how to unite and motivate a team. You are also focused on results, in order to achieve your goals effectively.
You have an analytical mind, with a structured approach and an ability to solve problems.
Languages
You are native French and also speak English. Any other language is an asset.
